relationships.subject: beta3 subunit
relationships.evidence_quote: the β3 subunit caused a pronounced decrease in maximal Na+ current amplitude (Imax) to 22 ± 4% of control

relationships.subject: beta3 subunit
relationships.evidence_quote: The β3 subunit strongly decelerated recovery from inactivation whereas the other β subunits were without effect

relationships.subject: beta1 subunit
relationships.evidence_quote: The β1 subunit caused a hyperpolarizing shift of 6.9 mV in the activation curve of hNav1.8

key_findings: Beta3 (not beta1/beta2) reduces hNav1.8 current amplitude and slows recovery from inactivation in oocytes.
The intracellular domain of beta3 mediates amplitude reduction; the extracellular domain mediates repriming effects.
